description: Public PlaceholderParser probes for output assignment, legacy indices, string decoding, boolean repetition, and interpolation.

mutants.description: Bypass output writability enforcement so assigning a parser-owned value no longer throws. The read-only assertion must fail while valid DynamicConfig output writes still succeed.
Drop one element when repeat(count,value) assigns a float output vector; the three-element readback must fail.
Ignore the requested filament index; subsequent legacy vector lookup must still select slots 1 and 2.
Decode the public \r escape as a newline; the escape round-trip oracle must distinguish carriage return from line feed.
Discard the boolean repeat value; the assignment case requires repeat(2,true) to retain two true values.
Use linear interpolation for nearly coincident coordinates; the off-midpoint probe distinguishes the required average of 20 from a linear result of 15.
